CREATE VIEW EDS.SYN_SuspectDuplicateReport AS

WITH CRM_ADDRESS AS (
    SELECT
    ECA.ORGKEY
    ,ECA.BANK_ID
    ,ECA.SCD_START_DATE
    ,ECA.SCD_END_DATE
    ,ECA.ADDRESS_LINE1
    ,ECA.ADDRESS_LINE2
    ,ECA.STATE
    ,ECA.CITY
    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ECA.ORGKEY, ECA.BANK_ID ORDER BY ECA.SCD_START_DATE DESC) RN
    FROM EDS.CRM_ADDRESS ECA
    WHERE TRIM(ECA.PREFERREDADDRESS) = 'Y'
    AND ECA.END_DATE = '2099-12-31'
    AND ECA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
    AND LEFT(TRIM(ECA.ORGKEY),1) = 'R'
    AND ECA.ACCOUNTID != 0
)

, CCD_BRANCH AS
(
    SELECT BRANCH_CODE, APPM_ACCT_NBR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APPM_ACCT_NBR ORDER BY BD DESC, ISMONTHLY DESC ) AS RN
    FROM
    (
    SELECT APPM_ACCT_NBR, SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE,7,4) AS BRANCH_CODE, 0 AS ISMONTHLY, LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) AS BD FROM busc.CCD_CBCEXAPPMP WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1 GROUP BY APPM_ACCT_NBR, SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE,7,4), LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT APPM_ACCT_NBR, SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE,7,4) AS BRANCH_CODE, 1 AS ISMONTHLY, LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) AS BD FROM busc.CCD_CBCEXAPPFP WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1 GROUP BY APPM_ACCT_NBR, SUBSTRING(APPM_SOURCE,7,4), LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)
    ) A
)

--DEP
, DEP AS (
    SELECT EDA.CUST_ID
    ,EDF.GAM_BANK_ID AS BANK_ID
    ,EDF.AS_OF_DATE
    ,EDF.FORACID
    ,EDF.GAM_SCHM_TYPE
    ,EDF.SOL_ID
    ,EDF.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS
    ,EDF.ACCT_OPN_DATE
    FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF
    JOIN EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
        ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
        AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
        AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
)
--LNS
, LNS AS (
    SELECT EDA.CUST_ID
    ,ELF.GAM_BANK_ID AS BANK_ID
    ,ELF.AS_OF_DATE
    ,ELF.FORACID
    ,ELF.GAM_SCHM_TYPE
    ,ELF.SOL_ID
    ,ELF.LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS
    ,ELF.ACCT_OPN_DATE
    FROM EDS.LOAN_FACT ELF
    JOIN EDS.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN EDA
        ON EDA.ACID = ELF.GAM_ACID
        AND EDA.BANK_ID = ELF.GAM_BANK_ID
        AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = ELF.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE ELF.GAM_BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
)
, TRU AS (
    SELECT 
    PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO
    ,PORT.SUB_BR_CD
    ,PORT.STATUS
    ,PFS.INCEPTION_DATE
    ,CUS.UNIQUE_ID
    FROM (SELECT PORTFOLIO_NO, BASE_NO, SUB_BR_CD, STATUS, SUBSCRIPTION_ID, isLatest, isActive, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PORTFOLIO_NO, BASE_NO, SUB_BR_CD, STATUS, SUBSCRIPTION_ID, isLatest, isActive ORDER BY LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)) RN
            FROM BUSC.TRU_PORTFOLIO) PORT
    JOIN BUSC.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION PFS
        ON PORT.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = PFS.SUBSCRIPTION_ID
        AND PFS.isActive = 1 AND PFS.isLatest = 1
    JOIN BUSC.TRU_BASELINK BSL
        ON BSL.CUST_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
        AND BSL.isActive = 1 AND BSL.isLatest = 1
    JOIN BUSC.TRU_CUST CUS
        ON CUS.CUST_NO = BSL.CIF_NO
        AND CUS.isActive = 1 AND CUS.isLatest = 1
    WHERE PORT.RN = 1 AND PORT.isActive = 1 AND PORT.isLatest = 1

)
--CRM-DEP
SELECT 
SCB.[Group] AS [Group]
,SCB.BASE_SCORE AS BaseScore
,ECD.ORGKEY AS SourceID
,ECD.ORGKEY AS FCBSCIF
,ECD.NAME AS CustomerName
,ECD.CUST_DOB AS DateOfBirth
,ECD.MAIDENNAMEOFMOTHER AS MothersMaidenName
,ECD.GENERALTAXID AS TaxIdentificationNumber
,CONCAT(TRIM(ECA.ADDRESS_LINE1),' ', TRIM(ECA.ADDRESS_LINE2))  AS AddressLine1AndAddressLine2
,CONCAT(TRIM(EMC.DESCRIPTION) ,' ', TRIM(EMS.DESCRIPTION)) AS CityAndProvince
,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS CifCreationDate
,DEP.FORACID AS AccountNumber
,DEP.GAM_SCHM_TYPE AS AccountType
,DEP.SOL_ID AS AccountSolId
,DEP.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS AS AccountStatus
,DEP.ACCT_OPN_DATE AS AccountOpeningDate
,ECD.ONLINE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT AS OnlineBankingIndicator
,ECD.MOBILE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT AS MobileBankingIndicator
,ECD.ATM_ENROLLMENT AS LinkedCardIndicator
FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults SCB
JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
    ON REPLACE(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR),'CBC_CRM_','') = ECD.ACCOUNTID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
    AND LEFT(TRIM(ECD.ORGKEY),1) = 'R'
    AND ECD.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
JOIN DEP DEP
    ON ECD.CORE_CUST_ID = DEP.CUST_ID
    AND ECD.BANK_ID = DEP.BANK_ID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE)= DEP.AS_OF_DATE
LEFT JOIN CRM_ADDRESS ECA
    ON ECD.ORGKEY = ECA.ORGKEY
    AND ECD.BANK_ID = ECA.BANK_ID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN ECA.SCD_START_DATE AND ECA.SCD_END_DATE
    AND ECA.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_CITY_DIM EMC
    ON ECA.CITY = EMC.VALUE
    AND ECA.BANK_ID = EMC.BANK_ID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN EMC.SCD_START_DATE AND EMC.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_STATE_DIM EMS
    ON ECA.STATE = EMS.VALUE
    AND ECA.BANK_ID = EMS.BANK_ID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN EMS.SCD_START_DATE AND EMS.SCD_END_DATE--load date same with Syn staging
WHERE LEFT(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR),7) = 'CBC_CRM'


UNION ALL

--CRM-LNS
SELECT 
SCB.[Group] AS [Group]
,SCB.BASE_SCORE AS BaseScore
,ECD.ORGKEY AS SourceID
,ECD.ORGKEY AS FCBSCIF
,ECD.NAME AS CustomerName
,ECD.CUST_DOB AS DateOfBirth
,ECD.MAIDENNAMEOFMOTHER AS MothersMaidenName
,ECD.GENERALTAXID AS TaxIdentificationNumber
,CONCAT(TRIM(ECA.ADDRESS_LINE1),' ', TRIM(ECA.ADDRESS_LINE2))  AS AddressLine1AndAddressLine2
,CONCAT(TRIM(EMC.DESCRIPTION) ,' ', TRIM(EMS.DESCRIPTION)) AS CityAndProvince
,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS CifCreationDate
,LNS.FORACID AS AccountNumber
,LNS.GAM_SCHM_TYPE AS AccountType
,LNS.SOL_ID AS AccountSolId
,LNS.LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS AS AccountStatus
,LNS.ACCT_OPN_DATE AS AccountOpeningDate
,ECD.ONLINE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT AS OnlineBankingIndicator
,ECD.MOBILE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT AS MobileBankingIndicator
,ECD.ATM_ENROLLMENT AS LinkedCardIndicator
FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults SCB
JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
    ON REPLACE(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR),'CBC_CRM_','') = ECD.ACCOUNTID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
    AND LEFT(TRIM(ECD.ORGKEY),1) = 'R'
    AND ECD.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
JOIN LNS LNS
    ON ECD.CORE_CUST_ID = LNS.CUST_ID
    AND ECD.BANK_ID = LNS.BANK_ID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE)= LNS.AS_OF_DATE
LEFT JOIN CRM_ADDRESS ECA
    ON ECD.ORGKEY = ECA.ORGKEY
    AND ECD.BANK_ID = ECA.BANK_ID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN ECA.SCD_START_DATE AND ECA.SCD_END_DATE
    AND ECA.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_CITY_DIM EMC
    ON ECA.CITY = EMC.VALUE
    AND ECA.BANK_ID = EMC.BANK_ID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN EMC.SCD_START_DATE AND EMC.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_STATE_DIM EMS
    ON ECA.STATE = EMS.VALUE
    AND ECA.BANK_ID = EMS.BANK_ID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN EMS.SCD_START_DATE AND EMS.SCD_END_DATE
WHERE LEFT(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR),7) = 'CBC_CRM'

UNION ALL

--CRM-TRU
SELECT 
SCB.[Group] AS [Group]
,SCB.BASE_SCORE AS BaseScore
,ECD.ORGKEY AS SourceID
,ECD.ORGKEY AS FCBSCIF
,ECD.NAME AS CustomerName
,ECD.CUST_DOB AS DateOfBirth
,ECD.MAIDENNAMEOFMOTHER AS MothersMaidenName
,ECD.GENERALTAXID AS TaxIdentificationNumber
,CONCAT(TRIM(ECA.ADDRESS_LINE1),' ', TRIM(ECA.ADDRESS_LINE2))  AS AddressLine1AndAddressLine2
,CONCAT(TRIM(EMC.DESCRIPTION) ,' ', TRIM(EMS.DESCRIPTION)) AS CityAndProvince
,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS CifCreationDate
,TRU.PORTFOLIO_NO AS AccountNumber
,'TRUST' AS AccountType
,TRU.SUB_BR_CD AS AccountSolId
,TRU.STATUS AS AccountStatus
,TRU.INCEPTION_DATE AS AccountOpeningDate
,ECD.ONLINE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT AS OnlineBankingIndicator
,ECD.MOBILE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT AS MobileBankingIndicator
,ECD.ATM_ENROLLMENT AS LinkedCardIndicator
FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults SCB
JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
    ON REPLACE(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR),'CBC_CRM_','') = ECD.ACCOUNTID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
    AND LEFT(TRIM(ECD.ORGKEY),1) = 'R'
    AND ECD.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
JOIN TRU TRU
    ON ECD.ORGKEY = TRU.UNIQUE_ID
LEFT JOIN CRM_ADDRESS ECA
    ON ECD.ORGKEY = ECA.ORGKEY
    AND ECD.BANK_ID = ECA.BANK_ID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN ECA.SCD_START_DATE AND ECA.SCD_END_DATE
    AND ECA.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_CITY_DIM EMC
    ON ECA.CITY = EMC.VALUE
    AND ECA.BANK_ID = EMC.BANK_ID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN EMC.SCD_START_DATE AND EMC.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_STATE_DIM EMS
    ON ECA.STATE = EMS.VALUE
    AND ECA.BANK_ID = EMS.BANK_ID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN EMS.SCD_START_DATE AND EMS.SCD_END_DATE
WHERE LEFT(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR),7) = 'CBC_CRM'

UNION ALL

--CRM-TRY
SELECT 
SCB.[Group] AS [Group]
,SCB.BASE_SCORE AS BaseScore
,ECD.ORGKEY AS SourceID
,ECD.ORGKEY AS FCBSCIF
,ECD.NAME AS CustomerName
,ECD.CUST_DOB AS DateOfBirth
,ECD.MAIDENNAMEOFMOTHER AS MothersMaidenName
,ECD.GENERALTAXID AS TaxIdentificationNumber
,CONCAT(TRIM(ECA.ADDRESS_LINE1),' ', TRIM(ECA.ADDRESS_LINE2))  AS AddressLine1AndAddressLine2
,CONCAT(TRIM(EMC.DESCRIPTION) ,' ', TRIM(EMS.DESCRIPTION)) AS CityAndProvince
,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS CifCreationDate
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,TRY.ID) AS AccountNumber
,'TREASURY' AS AccountType
,NULL AS AccountSolId
,NULL AS AccountStatus
,NULL AS AccountOpeningDate
,ECD.ONLINE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT AS OnlineBankingIndicator
,ECD.MOBILE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT AS MobileBankingIndicator
,ECD.ATM_ENROLLMENT AS LinkedCardIndicator
FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults SCB
JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
    ON REPLACE(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR),'CBC_CRM_','') = ECD.ACCOUNTID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
    AND LEFT(TRIM(ECD.ORGKEY),1) = 'R'
    AND ECD.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
JOIN (SELECT ID,BNK_CODE,VALUE AS CUST_ID,SCD_START_DATE, SCD_END_DATE FROM EDS.TRY_LEGALENTITY  BTL
        CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(BTL.External_Ref, '|')) TRY
    ON ECD.ORGKEY = TRY.CUST_ID
    AND ECD.BANK_ID = TRY.BNK_CODE
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN TRY.SCD_START_DATE AND TRY.SCD_END_DATE
--JOIN (SELECT TOP 1000 ID,BNK_CODE,VALUE AS CUST_ID,ISLATEST FROM BUSC.TRY_LEGALENTITY  BTL
--        CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(BTL.External_Ref, '|') WHERE ISLATEST = 1) TRY
--    ON ECD.ORGKEY = TRY.CUST_ID
--    AND ECD.BANK_ID = TRY.BNK_CODE
LEFT JOIN CRM_ADDRESS ECA
    ON ECD.ORGKEY = ECA.ORGKEY
    AND ECD.BANK_ID = ECA.BANK_ID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN ECA.SCD_START_DATE AND ECA.SCD_END_DATE
    AND ECA.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_CITY_DIM EMC
    ON ECA.CITY = EMC.VALUE
    AND ECA.BANK_ID = EMC.BANK_ID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN EMC.SCD_START_DATE AND EMC.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_STATE_DIM EMS
    ON ECA.STATE = EMS.VALUE
    AND ECA.BANK_ID = EMS.BANK_ID
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN EMS.SCD_START_DATE AND EMS.SCD_END_DATE
WHERE LEFT(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR),7) = 'CBC_CRM'

UNION ALL
--CCD
SELECT 
SCB.[Group] AS [Group]
,SCB.BASE_SCORE AS BaseScore
,ECF.CUST_NBR AS SourceID
,ECF.CUST_CIF_NBR AS FCBSCIF
,ECF.CUST_LOCAL_NAME AS CustomerName
,CONVERT(DATE,CAST(ECF.CUST_DTE_BIRTH AS VARCHAR(20)))AS DateOfBirth
,ECF.CUST_MOM_NAME AS MothersMaidenName
,ECF.CUST_TAX_ID AS TaxIdentificationNumber
,CONCAT(ECF.CUST_ADDR1 ,' ', ECF.CUST_ADDR2)  AS AddressLine1AndAddressLine2
,CONCAT (ECF.CUST_ADD_CITY, ' ', ECF.CUST_ADD_PROVINCE) AS CityAndProvince
,CONVERT(DATE,CAST(ECF.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN AS VARCHAR(20))) AS CifCreationDate
,ECF.CRDACCT_NBR AS AccountNumber
,'CREDIT CARD' AS AccountType
,ECB.BRANCH_CODE AS AccountSolId
,ECF.CRDACCT_STATUS AS AccountStatus
,CONVERT(DATE,CAST(ECF.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN AS VARCHAR(20))) AS AccountOpeningDate
,ECD.ONLINE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT AS OnlineBankingIndicator
,ECD.MOBILE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT AS MobileBankingIndicator
,ECD.ATM_ENROLLMENT AS LinkedCardIndicator
FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults SCB
JOIN EDS.CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT ECF
    ON REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR),'CBC_CARDS_','') = CONVERT(VARCHAR,ECF.CUST_NBR)
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) = ECF.AS_OF_DATE
JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
    ON ECF.CUST_CIF_NBR = ECD.ORGKEY
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN CCD_BRANCH ECB
    ON ECF.CRDACCT_NBR = ECB.APPM_ACCT_NBR
    AND ECB.RN = 1
WHERE LEFT(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR),8) = 'CBC_CARD'

UNION ALL
--SEC
SELECT 
SCB.[Group] AS [Group]
,SCB.BASE_SCORE AS BaseScore
,NULL AS SourceID
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,EST.CLTCODE) AS FCBSCIF
,CONCAT(TRIM(EST.FNAME), ' ', TRIM(EST.MNAME), ' ', TRIM(EST.LNAME)) AS CustomerName
,EST.BDATE AS DateOfBirth
,EST.MOTHER AS MothersMaidenName
,EST.TIN AS TaxIdentificationNumber
,EST.HOME_ADDR1 AS AddressLine1AndAddressLine2
,CONCAT(EST.HOME_ADDR2, ' ', EST.HOME_ADDR3) AS CityAndProvince
,EST.DATE_CREATED AS CifCreationDate
,ETA.ACCTCODE AS AccountNumber
,'SECURITIES' AS AccountType
,NULL AS AccountSolId
,ETA.STATUS AS AccountStatus
,ETA.DATE_OPEN AS AccountOpeningDate
,NULL AS OnlineBankingIndicator
,NULL AS MobileBankingIndicator
,NULL AS LinkedCardIndicator
FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults SCB 
JOIN EDS.SEC_TBLCLIENT EST
    ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,TRIM(SUBSTRING(TRIM(SUBSTRING(TRIM(SUBSTRING(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR), CHARINDEX('_',TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR))+1, LEN(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR)))), CHARINDEX('_',TRIM(SUBSTRING(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR), CHARINDEX('_',TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR))+1, LEN(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR)))))+1, LEN(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR)))),1,CHARINDEX('_',TRIM(SUBSTRING(TRIM(SUBSTRING(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR), CHARINDEX('_',TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR))+1, LEN(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR)))), CHARINDEX('_',TRIM(SUBSTRING(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR), CHARINDEX('_',TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR))+1, LEN(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR)))))+1, LEN(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR)))))-1))) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,EST.CLTCODE)
    AND EST.CLTTYPE = 'I'
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN EST.SCD_START_DATE AND EST.SCD_END_DATE 
JOIN EDS.SEC_ACCTLINK ESA
    ON EST.CLTCODE = ESA.CLTCODE
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN ESA.SCD_START_DATE AND ESA.SCD_END_DATE 
JOIN EDS.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS ETA
    ON ESA.ACCTKEY = ETA.ACCTKEY
    AND CAST(SCB.LOAD_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN ETA.SCD_START_DATE AND ETA.SCD_END_DATE 
WHERE LEFT(TRIM(SCB.ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR),5) = 'CBSec' 


------------------------------------------END VIEW

    CUSTOMER_DIM.ORGKEY = CRM_ADDRESS.ORGKEY

    CUSTOMER_DIM.BANK_ID = CRM_ADDRESS.BANK_ID

    AND
    CRM_ADDRESS.BANK_ID = MV_CITY_DIM.BANK_ID

    REPLACE(CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR,'CBC_CRM_','') = CUSTOMER_DIM.ACCOUNTID

(DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP

)

AND

[CUSTOMER_DIM to TRU_CUST]
CUSTOMER_DIM.ORGKEY = TRU_CUST.UNIQUE_NO
AND 
TRU_CUST.isActive = 1 AND TRU_CUST.isLatest = 1

[TRU_CUST to TRU_BASELINK]
TRU_CUST.CUST_NO = TRU_BASELINK.CIF_NO
AND
TRU_BASELINK.isActive = 1 AND TRU_BASELINK.isLatest = 1

[TRU_BASELINK to TRU_PORTFOLIO]
TRU_BASELINK.CUST_NO = TRU_PORTFOLIO.BASE_NO
AND
TRU_PORTFOLIO.isActive = 1 AND TRU_PORTFOLIO.isLatest = 1 AND TRU_PORTFOLIO.RN = 1


--Fetch the unique PORTFOLIO_NO, BASE_NO, SUB_BR_CD, STATUS, SUBSCRIPTION_ID, isLatest, isActive in TRU_PORTFOLIO

WITH TRU_PORTFOLIO AS
(
SELECT
PORTFOLIO_NO, BASE_NO, SUB_BR_CD, STATUS, SUBSCRIPTION_ID, isLatest, isActive, 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PORTFOLIO_NO, BASE_NO, SUB_BR_CD, STATUS, SUBSCRIPTION_ID, isLatest, isActive ORDER BY LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)) RN
FROM eds.TRU_PORTFOLIO
)

[TRU_PORTFOLIO to TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION]
TRU_PORTFOLIO.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION.SUBSCRIPTION_ID
AND
TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION.isActive = 1 AND TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION.isLatest = 1

TRU_CUST
TRU_BASELINK

TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION

CUSTOMER_DIM.ORGKEY = TRY_LEGALENTITY.EXTERNAL_REF
AND

CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(BTL.External_Ref, '|')

select ID,VALUE AS CUST_ID,ISLATEST FROM busc.try_legalentity  btl
CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(BTL.External_Ref, '|')
WHERE external_ref like '%R%'
order by 2 desc

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY ID) RN, * FROM eds.TRY_LegalEntity BTL --ON BTLD.ID = BTL.ID AND BTLD.Status = BTL.Status AND BTL.ISLATEST = 1
CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(BTL.External_Ref, '|')



--Fetch the unique Branch Code of the CCD Account from CCD_CBCEXAPPMP (Daily) & CCD_CBCEXAPPFP (Monthly), whichever is latest.


CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT.CRDACCT_NBR = CCD_BRANCH.APPM_ACCT_NBR
AND 
CCD_BRANCH.RN = 1

CONVERT(DATE,CAST(E.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN AS VARCHAR(20)))

CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT.CUST_NBR = CUSTOMER_DIM.ORGKEY
AND
CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CUSTOMER_DIM.SCD_START_DATE AND CUSTOMER_DIM.SCD_END_DATE

CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults.ACCOUNT_ID_CUST_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CARD%'

Driving Table: 
CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults

Inner Join:
CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT
    REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR),'CBC_CARDS_','') = CONVERT(VARCHAR,CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT.CUST_NBR)
CUSTOMER_DIM
    CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT.CUST_NBR = CUSTOMER_DIM.ORGKEY
    AND
    CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CUSTOMER_DIM.SCD_START_DATE AND CUSTOMER_DIM.SCD_END_DATE
    

Driving Table: 
CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults

Inner Join:
SEC_TBLCLIENT
SEC_TBLACCOUNT
SEC_ACCOUNTLINK

SEC_TBLCLIENT.CLTCODE = SEC.ACCOUNTLINK.CLTCODE
AND
SEC_ACCOUNTLINK.ACCTKEY = SEC_TBLACCOUNT.ACCTKEY
AND
CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults.LOAD_DATE BETWEEN SEC_ACCOUNTLINK.SCD_START_DATE AND SEC_ACCOUNTLINK.SCD_END_DATE
AND 
CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults.LOAD_DATE BETWEEN SEC_TBLACCOUNT.SCD_START_DATE AND SEC_TBLACCOUNT.SCD_END_DATE

CONVERT(VARCHAR,SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR, 40, LEN(CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR)-40),0, CHARINDEX('_',SUBSTRING(CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR, 40, LEN(CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults.ACCOUNTID_CUST_NBR))))) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,SEC_TBLCLIENT.CLTCODE)
